analysisSpecification: W021.5 Spatial Containment Analysis (Postal Geographies vs Assembly Constituencies)
directive: CTO Directive 149 / Workstream F / Task EB-04
governingAuthority: Master Execution Framework Amendment v1.6 / Rule IV-001 Non-Self-Acceptance

category1_strictlyContained.description: Postal polygon is >= 95% spatially contained within a single statutory Assembly Constituency
category1_strictlyContained.typicalGeography: Rural districts, remote blocks, single-town mandals/tehsils
category1_strictlyContained.civicResolutionPolicy: Deterministic auto-resolution to primary AC permitted

category2_multiAcIntersecting.description: Postal polygon intersects two or more Assembly Constituencies with significant area (> 5% in secondary AC)
category2_multiAcIntersecting.typicalGeography: Tier-1 and Tier-2 metropolitan areas, municipal corporation wards, urban sprawls
category2_multiAcIntersecting.civicResolutionPolicy: FAIL-CLOSED: Single-AC assignment strictly prohibited without user landmark/locality or polling station disambiguation

category3_interDistrictOrStateBorder.description: Postal polygon crosses administrative district or state boundaries due to historical postal delivery routing
category3_interDistrictOrStateBorder.typicalGeography: State borders, tri-junctions, river valleys, railway corridor beats

architecturalEnforcement.engine: PostGIS ST_Intersects / ST_Intersection Area Ratio Analysis
architecturalEnforcement.failClosedRule: No postal-code to constituency lookup table may declare a unique constraint on pincode without an associated constituency disambiguation key.

geospatialConfiguration.geometryRepairPolicy: ST_MakeValid applied on multi-polygons prior to intersection
geospatialConfiguration.disclaimer: Spatial analysis performed on 6-digit PIN code delivery areas. Operational postman delivery beat analysis cannot be performed until DoP delivery beat polygon layer is made available.
